title: Reasoning-targeted Jailbreak Attacks on Large Reasoning Models via Semantic Triggers and Psychological Framing
reasoning: The paper extensively explores moral and ethical components by leveraging Bandura's Moral Disengagement theory to design attacks that induce models to 'rationalize ethically questionable actions' and 'unethical strategies.' It evaluates these attacks using a Harmfulness Score and discusses the model's internalized sense of responsibility and moral self-sanctions.
